name: helix-picker
description: Helix-style fuzzy file picker and workspace search with preview

enumDescriptions: Centered overlay above the editor, like Helix.
A tab in the active editor group.

helixPicker.fontSize.description: Font size of the picker in pixels.

helixPicker.previewTheme.markdownDescription: Helix theme for syntax highlighting (for example `gruvbox_light_hard`). `auto` uses the Helix theme named like the VS Code color theme, else Helix's GitHub light or dark theme.

helixPicker.saturation.markdownDescription: Factor on the highlight colors' saturation. Colors that are already as saturated as the screen allows get a little lighter to make room; `1` keeps the theme's colors.

helixPicker.boldKeywords.description: Show keywords (if, return, struct, #include, fn, ...) in bold.

helixPicker.helixRuntime.markdownDescription: Helix runtime directory with `grammars/`, `queries/` and `themes/`. Empty searches `$HELIX_RUNTIME`, `~/.config/helix/runtime` and the usual install locations, including the snap.
